item.description:
Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1405

Deep

  • New: DeepExpression (an expression a channel on every sample: color, front and back depth), DeepReformat, DeepFromFrames, and DeepToPoints (kept for scripts; its points aren't drawn yet).
  • DeepFromImage drops samples with no alpha, as it should.

New nodes and commands

  • MatchGrade (Color): Analyze grades the source to look like the target, as a 3D LUT or a CDL.
  • Edit > Node > Split and join views: the selected node made once a view, so each eye can be set on its own.

Viewer

  • Stereo shown Interlaced (alternate rows) or Flicker (alternate frames), beside Anaglyph and Side by side.
  • Compare > Contact sheet: every input connected to the Viewer in a grid.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1393

Fixes

  • The Viewer showed nothing for a stereo comp (builds 1380 to 1392): it shows the comp's views again.

Viewer

  • Bar 2's saturation works: the picture shown grayer or stronger, for the eye only.
  • In a stereo comp the view menu also offers Anaglyph (left in red, right in cyan) and Side by side.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1392

Deep

  • A Read of a deep EXR reads its samples, as DeepRead does; DeepWrite writes them.
  • New in Deep: DeepMerge2 (combine and holdout), DeepToImage2, DeepFromImage, DeepRecolor, DeepHoldout2, DeepCrop, DeepTransform, DeepColorCorrect2 and DeepSample.
  • The Viewer shows a deep image flattened.

New nodes

  • MultiMerge (Merge): a layer stack in one node. Input 1 is the background and each input after it a layer with its own operation, mix and on switch. Its inputs appear one at a time as you connect them. A .nk gets a group of Merge2s that renders the same.
  • PlanarTracker (Transform): draw the plane's four corners in the Viewer, then Track follows it both ways from the reference frame. Create pin makes a CornerPin2D that carries a picture along, or holds the plane still.
  • Stabilize2D (one or two points), Precomp, MarkerRemoval, DustBust and Bokeh (a disc for now).

Stereo

  • A .nk's knob split by view (a right-eye value) now opens with each view's value and saves back as it was.

Viewer and graph

  • The M chip works: alpha shown as a tint over the picture, its color and opacity on the Viewer node. Viewer > False color shows brightness in stops from middle gray, with NaN and infinite pixels in magenta.
  • Settings > Preferences > Viewer: a Color background of any color, and the checkerboard's two colors and size.
  • Settings > Preferences > Node Graph: grid dots, from off to four times as bright.
  • Edit > Node > Precomp selected (Shift+Cmd+P): the selected nodes saved as a comp of their own and replaced by a Precomp.

Fixes

  • A node whose inputs grow as they're connected (Merge2's A3 and on, Blend) got no port for them in the Node Graph.
